summary: Ellomay Capital Ltd., an Israeli renewable-energy and power company listed in the US via ADRs (foreign private issuer), furnished a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, attaching its October 2026 investor presentation as Exhibit 99.1. The filing is a routine disclosure of investor-relations materials describing project pipeline, forecast electricity prices, tariff assumptions, and development-stage assets; it contains no transaction, stake, price, or board recommendation. No special-situation event is disclosed, so no deal terms, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock apply. No risk-arb angle; watch only for follow-on operational or financing updates.
